decisions.reason: Because this email-to-SMS gateway is close to our existing secure messaging and integration capabilities, our strong in-house R&D and platform knowledge give us good absorptive capacity to learn from early use and improve it, so withdrawal risk is low but not negligible.

Because this SMS-to-email gateway also builds directly on our established cloud communication stack and customer base, we can readily absorb feedback and refine it, though its adjacent and potentially narrower use case makes the withdrawal risk slightly higher than for Product B.
